*   **Cost of Sales (FY2017):** $111,934 million

$$\text{Average Accounts Payable} = \frac{\$25,309 + \$34,616}{2} = \frac{\$59,925}{2} = \$29,962.50 \text{ million}$$

$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times \frac{\$29,962.50}{\$116,520} = 365 \times 0.2571447 = 93.86$}$
